text1: Light boarding fighter. Each successful contact with a target ship counts as 1 boarding hit toward capture progress. CR is zeroed after a contact; it must return to its carrier to resupply before it can board again.

Medium boarding fighter. A successful contact within touch range counts as 2 boarding hits toward capture progress. CR is zeroed after a contact; it must return to its carrier to resupply before it can board again. Sturdier than the light fighter with a frontal shield, suited for boarding mid-sized targets under heavier fire.

Heavy boarding fighter. A successful contact within touch range counts as 5 boarding hits toward capture progress. CR is zeroed after a contact; it must return to its carrier to resupply before it can board again. Thick armor and no shield make it a dedicated ram, suited for boarding cruisers and capitals.
